title: Choose
subtitle: 「選擇／挑選／決定採用」，有哪些真正接近、廣泛可用，或在特定語境中很自然的替代表達？
description: 「選擇／挑選／決定採用」，有哪些真正接近、廣泛可用，或在特定語境中很自然的替代表達？

words.note: 和 choose 最接近的正式／中性近義詞之一。
words.example: Please select one option from the list.
words.exampleZh: 請從清單中選擇一個選項。

exercises.original: Please choose one option from the list.
exercises.zh: 請從清單中選擇一個選項。
exercises.upgrade: Please select one option from the list.

options.explanation: 正式、中性，和 choose 幾乎可直接互換。
只表示偏好，不一定真的選了。
表示提名某人，不適合一般選項。
表示批准，不一定涉及多個選項。
表示推薦，選擇權未必在說話者。

exercises.original: The panel chose three candidates for the final interview.
exercises.zh: 評審小組挑選三名候選人進入最後面試。
exercises.upgrade: The panel selected three candidates for the final interview.

options.explanation: 提名未必代表最後入選。
批准不等於從候選人中挑選。
偏好不一定產生正式選擇結果。

exercises.original: Users can choose their preferred language from the menu.
exercises.zh: 使用者可從選單選擇偏好的語言。
exercises.upgrade: Users can select their preferred language from the menu.

words.note: 非常自然、口語，很多日常語境都可直接代替 choose。

exercises.original: Choose whichever colour you like.
exercises.zh: 選你喜歡的任何顏色。
exercises.upgrade: Pick whichever colour you like.

exercises.original: She chose a sandwich from the menu.
exercises.zh: 她從餐牌挑了一份三文治。
exercises.upgrade: She picked a sandwich from the menu.

exercises.original: You can choose any seat that is still free.
exercises.zh: 你可以挑任何仍然空著的座位。
exercises.upgrade: You can pick any seat that is still free.

words.note: 表示在幾個方案中選擇其中一個，常帶「經過考慮後決定」的感覺。
words.example: We opted for the cheaper package.
words.exampleZh: 我們選擇了較便宜的套餐。

exercises.original: We chose the cheaper package.
exercises.zh: 我們選擇了較便宜的套餐。
exercises.upgrade: We opted for the cheaper package.

options.explanation: 幾個方案中選擇一個，非常自然。
批准某方案，但不一定表示是自己從中選擇。

exercises.original: She chose to travel by train rather than fly.
exercises.zh: 她選擇乘火車而不是坐飛機。
exercises.upgrade: She opted to travel by train rather than fly.

options.explanation: opt to do 表示選擇做某事。

exercises.original: Many customers choose the monthly payment plan.
exercises.zh: 很多顧客選擇月付計劃。
exercises.upgrade: Many customers opt for the monthly payment plan.

options.explanation: 套餐／付款方式選擇很自然。

words.note: 表示經過考慮後，最終決定某個人、物或方案。
words.example: Have you decided on a venue yet?

exercises.original: Have you chosen a venue yet?
exercises.zh: 你已經選定場地了嗎？
exercises.upgrade: Have you decided on a venue yet?

options.explanation: 表示經考慮後作出最後選擇。

exercises.original: After comparing the options, they chose a new supplier.
exercises.zh: 比較各個選項後，他們選定了新供應商。
exercises.upgrade: After comparing the options, they decided on a new supplier.

options.explanation: after comparing 強調最後決定。
可能只是批准別人的選擇。

exercises.original: We still haven't chosen which date to use.
exercises.zh: 我們仍未決定選哪個日期。
exercises.upgrade: We still haven't decided on a date.

options.explanation: 最自然地表示尚未作最後選擇。

words.note: 表示考慮過幾個選項後，終於決定其中一個。
words.example: After discussing several ideas, we settled on a simple design.
words.exampleZh: 討論幾個構思後，我們最後選定簡單的設計。

exercises.original: After considering several designs, we chose the simplest one.
exercises.zh: 考慮幾個設計後，我們最後選定最簡單的一個。
exercises.upgrade: After considering several designs, we settled on the simplest one.

options.explanation: 表示比較後終於定下來。
批准不一定表示自己選定。

exercises.original: They discussed several names before choosing “Harbour House.”
exercises.zh: 他們討論幾個名稱後，最後選定「Harbour House」。
exercises.upgrade: They discussed several names before settling on “Harbour House.”

options.explanation: 多個選項後最後敲定名稱。
批准，不突出比較後選擇。

exercises.original: We eventually chose a compromise solution.
exercises.zh: 我們最後選定了一個折衷方案。
exercises.upgrade: We eventually settled on a compromise solution.

words.note: 非常常見的口語表達，表示在幾個選項中決定採用某一個。
words.example: I think I'll go with the blue one.

exercises.original: I think I'll choose the blue one.
exercises.zh: 我想我會選藍色那個。
exercises.upgrade: I think I'll go with the blue one.

exercises.original: Which dessert are you going to choose?
exercises.zh: 你打算選哪款甜品？
exercises.upgrade: Which dessert are you going to go with?

options.explanation: 用餐選擇的口語表達很自然。

exercises.original: We chose the simpler layout in the end.
exercises.zh: 我們最後決定採用較簡單的版面。
exercises.upgrade: We went with the simpler layout in the end.

options.explanation: 設計方案的口語選擇很自然。

words.note: 表示從一堆人或物中找出、挑出某一個或幾個。
words.example: She picked out a dress for the ceremony.
words.exampleZh: 她挑了一條裙子出席典禮。

exercises.original: She chose a dress from the rack.
exercises.zh: 她從衣架上挑出一條裙子。
exercises.upgrade: She picked out a dress from the rack.

options.explanation: 從一堆衣服中挑出一件，非常自然。

exercises.original: Can you choose the best photograph from these twenty?
exercises.zh: 你可以從這二十張照片中挑出最好的一張嗎？
exercises.upgrade: Can you pick out the best photograph from these twenty?

options.explanation: 明確表示從眾多項目中挑出一個。
可提名最佳作品，但不等於最終挑出。

exercises.original: He chose three books from the shelf.
exercises.zh: 他從書架挑出三本書。
exercises.upgrade: He picked out three books from the shelf.

options.explanation: 從實體選項中挑出，很自然。

words.note: 非常自然的名詞型改寫。
words.example: You need to make a choice before Friday.
words.exampleZh: 你需要在星期五前作出選擇。

exercises.original: You need to choose before Friday.
exercises.zh: 你需要在星期五前作出選擇。
exercises.upgrade: You need to make a choice before Friday.

options.explanation: 不自然，而且批准不等於選擇。

exercises.original: She found it difficult to choose between the two offers.
exercises.zh: 她覺得很難在兩個提議之間作出選擇。
exercises.upgrade: She found it difficult to make a choice between the two offers.

options.explanation: between two offers 是典型選擇語境。

exercises.original: Customers can choose from four different plans.
exercises.zh: 顧客可以從四個不同計劃中作出選擇。
exercises.upgrade: Customers can make a choice from four different plans.

words.note: 比 make a choice 更正式。
words.example: Customers can make a selection from the available designs.
words.exampleZh: 顧客可從現有設計中作出選擇。

exercises.original: Please choose from the available designs.
exercises.zh: 請從現有設計中作出選擇。
exercises.upgrade: Please make a selection from the available designs.

exercises.original: Customers choose a fabric before placing the order.
exercises.zh: 顧客落單前會選定布料。
exercises.upgrade: Customers make a selection of fabric before placing the order.

exercises.original: Applicants must choose one of the three available routes.
exercises.zh: 申請人必須從三條可用路線中作出選擇。
exercises.upgrade: Applicants must make a selection from the three available routes.

words.note: 表示透過正式投票選某人擔任職位。

exercises.original: Members chose her as chairperson by vote.
exercises.zh: 成員透過投票選她擔任主席。
exercises.upgrade: Members elected her as chairperson.

options.explanation: 透過正式投票選人擔任職位。
任命可能由上級決定，不一定投票。

exercises.original: The shareholders chose three new directors in the annual vote.
exercises.zh: 股東在年度投票中選出三名新董事。
exercises.upgrade: The shareholders elected three new directors.

options.explanation: 由單方面任命，與投票不同。

exercises.original: Voters chose a new mayor last year.
exercises.zh: 選民去年選出新市長。
exercises.upgrade: Voters elected a new mayor last year.

options.explanation: 選民投票選官員，最精確。

words.note: 表示以投票方式選擇某候選人或方案。
words.example: Most members voted for the second proposal.
words.exampleZh: 大部分成員投票支持第二個方案。

exercises.original: Most members chose the second proposal in the vote.
exercises.zh: 大部分成員投票支持第二個方案。
exercises.upgrade: Most members voted for the second proposal.

options.explanation: 明確以投票方式作出選擇。
最終採用可能是結果，但不是「投哪一票」。

exercises.original: Which candidate did you choose in the election?
exercises.zh: 你在選舉中投票選了哪位候選人？
exercises.upgrade: Which candidate did you vote for in the election?

options.explanation: 問題問的是個人投票選擇。

exercises.original: The committee chose Plan B by a six-to-four vote.
exercises.zh: 委員會以六比四投票選擇 B 方案。
exercises.upgrade: Six members voted for Plan B.

words.note: 表示正式選定某人、某物或某地作特定角色／用途。
words.example: The committee designated this room as the emergency centre.
words.exampleZh: 委員會指定這個房間作緊急中心。

exercises.original: The committee chose this room as the emergency centre.
exercises.zh: 委員會指定這個房間作緊急中心。
exercises.upgrade: The committee designated this room as the emergency centre.

options.explanation: 正式指定某物作特定用途。

exercises.original: The organization chose one day as its annual volunteer day.
exercises.zh: 機構指定一天作年度義工日。
exercises.upgrade: The organization designated one day as its annual volunteer day.

exercises.original: The city chose the old station as a protected heritage site.
exercises.zh: 城市把舊車站指定為受保護文化遺產地點。
exercises.upgrade: The city designated the old station as a protected heritage site.

options.explanation: 官方指定身份／用途，非常自然。
可以提名遺產地位，但不等於最終正式指定。

words.note: 表示選擇某人並正式讓他／她擔任職位。
words.example: The board appointed her as managing director.
words.exampleZh: 董事會任命她為董事總經理。

exercises.original: The board chose her to be managing director.
exercises.zh: 董事會選定並任命她為董事總經理。
exercises.upgrade: The board appointed her as managing director.

options.explanation: 選定某人並正式授予職位。
分配工作，不等於正式職位任命。
推薦未必成為正式結果。
designate 可指定用途，但此處是任命人。

exercises.original: The university chose a new dean after an international search.
exercises.zh: 大學在全球招聘後選定並任命新院長。
exercises.upgrade: The university appointed a new dean after an international search.

options.explanation: 可指定，但不如 appoint 精確。

exercises.original: The company chose him to lead the new division.
exercises.zh: 公司選定他領導新部門。
exercises.upgrade: The company appointed him to lead the new division.

options.explanation: 正式選定某人擔任角色。
只是分配任務，正式程度不同。

words.note: 當 choose 指選擇某種方法、政策、策略或做法時很自然。
words.example: The school adopted a new approach to language teaching.
words.exampleZh: 學校採用了一種新的語言教學方法。

exercises.original: The school chose a new approach to language teaching.
exercises.zh: 學校採用新的語言教學方法。
exercises.upgrade: The school adopted a new approach to language teaching.

options.explanation: 方法／策略被選擇並正式使用。

exercises.original: The company chose a more flexible working policy.
exercises.zh: 公司採用較靈活的工作政策。
exercises.upgrade: The company adopted a more flexible working policy.

options.explanation: adopt a policy 是固定自然搭配。

exercises.original: The research team chose a different method for analysing the data.
exercises.zh: 研究團隊採用了不同的數據分析方法。
exercises.upgrade: The research team adopted a different method for analysing the data.

options.explanation: 方法被選中並實際使用。
批准不一定表示研究團隊實際採用。

falseSynonyms.zh: 偏好不等於真正作出選擇 你可以 prefer A，但最後仍 choose B。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON I prefer the red one. I chose the blue one.

falseSynonyms.zh: 決定不一定是「選」 decide 可以決定做／不做某事； choose 通常涉及選項。
提名不等於選出 nominate 只是提出某人作候選人； elect / choose 才是選出。
推薦不等於選擇 你可以推薦某個選項，但最終選擇權仍在別人手上。
批准不等於選擇 approve 表示接受／批准某個已提出的方案，不代表你從多個方案中選出它。
分配不等於挑選 assign 是把任務、角色、座位等分配給某人。
詞性陷阱 - choose = 動詞 - choice = 名詞 - chosen = 過去分詞／形容詞
詞性與意思不同 - select = 動詞，選擇 - selection = 名詞，選擇／選集 - selective = 形容詞，挑剔的／選擇性的
